workLog.activity: Traced why comparison.head and endingCommit drift
workLog.finding: The committed schema already documents the divergence the check rejects. session-log.schema.json:170-174 defines commitHead as the "Latest commit authored by this session when QA rebinding advances comparison.head", and extract_session_episode.py:831-832 carries the same reading. endingCommit moves on an unrelated schedule under session-logs.md MUST 2 and MUST 3. Two fields advanced by two operations at two times were being compared for equality.

workLog.activity: Measured the blast radius of the binding commit after ADR-096
workLog.finding: QaBinding.commit is barely load-bearing now. validate_qa_report() reads expected.session_log and never expected.commit, and validate_session_json.py:983 uses binding.commit only when live-HEAD resolution fails, since validation_head auto-resolves at :1641-1642. The raise was blocking the whole QA-evidence check to protect a value that is normally never read, which is what argues against a mechanical ADR-096 copy.

workLog.activity: Measured incidence across the committed corpus
workLog.finding: Of 1458 committed session logs, 1417 carry no full-SHA comparison.head so the check cannot fire, 34 agree, and 1 disagrees. The 1 has qaValidation null so it never reaches the function. The figure undercounts by construction: the rebind loop edits a disagreeing log into agreement before committing, so closed loops are filed under the 34.

workLog.activity: Reviewed ADR-099 through the six adr-review lenses
workLog.finding: No independent agents ran; the harness registers no subagent-spawn tool, confirmed by ToolSearch. Recorded as a single-reviewer review in the debate log rather than reported as a 6/6 tally, since check_adr_review_policy is structural and a fabricated tally would pass it. Seven findings applied. Two changed the argument: the drift can run either way and the laxer direction is saved by post_qa_code_changes's ancestry check, and the corpus figure needed its undercount caveat. One corrected a specific and wrong citation, copy_lib_to_platform, which does not exist; the generator is _build_lib at build/scripts/build_all.py:316.
